scenario: 100 canonical SQLite reads, 1000 synthetic users, median of 5 repetitions in separate Node processes; same database schema and query

before.strategy: open, migrate and validate migration hashes, query, close on every operation

after.strategy: reuse connection, migrate once, check file identity and projection state

limitations: Synthetic helper benchmark, not end-to-end page latency, production load, or total laptop RAM. No real Google requests. Preview services stopped. Results are observations, not general guarantees.
